gloss: to shoulder, to carry on one's shoulder; to trick

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {担|かつ}いでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to shoulder, to carry on one's shoulder
definitions.explanation: To support and carry something heavy on one's shoulder.

definitions.gloss: to set up (as a leader), to promote
definitions.explanation: To support someone as a candidate or leader.
To fool someone as a prank or joke.

examples.english: I was cleverly tricked by my seniors and took it seriously.

notes:
{担|かつ}ぐ means to carry something on one's shoulder. It also has a colloquial meaning of 'to trick.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: Xを{担|かつ}ぐ

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{担|かつ}ぐ (to carry a portable shrine)
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{担|かつ}ぐ (to shoulder luggage)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{担|かつ}ぐ (to trick/deceive someone)
- ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{担|かつ}ぐ (to back a candidate)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{神輿|みこし}を{担|かつ}ぐ is an important activity in Japanese ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧, where teams carry heavy portable shrines through the streets.

SIMILAR VERBS:
- ⟦{背負|せお}う→背負う：16159_seou⟧ (to carry on one's back)
- ⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ (to hold in one's arms)
